verdict.rationale: Asaas documents its own automatic notifications before and after the due date, including email, which covers the dunning and recovery-email part of the story for overdue charges. It also offers Serasa negativação for recovering overdue charges, and subscriptions are a listed feature. There is no evidence of automatic retry of failed subscription card payments or of smart retry logic. Missing for 10: automatic retry of failed subscription payments, smart/adaptive retry scheduling, dunning tied specifically to failed subscription charges, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can automatically retry failed subscription payments with smart dunning and recovery emails

citations.quote: Envie notificações automáticas antes e depois do vencimento. Você escolhe os canais: WhatsApp, e-mail, SMS ou robô de voz.
Recupere o dinheiro das cobranças vencidas com a negativação no Serasa.
Features such as subscriptions, payment links, split, receivables anticipation, subaccounts, invoices, and Webhooks are also available.
